risk_types.label: Unilateral Exemption
risk_types.description: Clauses that exempt only the employer from liability while imposing obligations on the employee.
risk_types.risk_explanation: One-sided disclaimers that remove employer accountability are a major red flag and are often difficult to enforce.

risk_types.label: Excessive Penalty / Liquidated Damages
risk_types.description: Penalty or liquidated damages clauses that impose disproportionate financial obligations on the employee.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Penalty amounts significantly exceeding typical salary/training costs may be unenforceable but still create undue pressure.

risk_types.label: Vague Termination Conditions
risk_types.description: Termination provisions that are ambiguous, overly broad, or give the employer unchecked discretion.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Vague triggers (e.g., 'sole discretion' / 'deemed unsuitable') can enable arbitrary dismissal disputes.

risk_types.label: Probation Period Risk
risk_types.description: Probation clauses that are unreasonably long or lack clear evaluation criteria.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Unreasonably broad probation terms can lead to underpayment or termination without objective criteria.

risk_types.label: Wage / Payment Terms Unclear
risk_types.description: Salary, bonus, or payment schedule provisions that are vague, conditional, or subject to unilateral change.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Unclear wage formulas and payment timing create a high risk of underpayment or delayed payment.

risk_types.label: Overtime / Leave Policy Unclear
risk_types.description: Work hour, overtime, or leave provisions that are ambiguous or disadvantageous to the employee.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Ambiguous overtime/leave terms can result in excessive unpaid overtime and reduced employee protections.

risk_types.label: Non-Compete Restriction
risk_types.description: Post-employment restrictions on working for competitors or starting competing businesses.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Overbroad non-compete clauses without adequate compensation may severely limit future employment options.

risk_types.label: IP Ownership Assignment
risk_types.description: Provisions transferring intellectual property rights created by the employee to the employer.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Overly broad IP assignment clauses may claim ownership of work products beyond job duties.

risk_types.label: Confidentiality / NDA
risk_types.description: Obligations imposed on the employee to protect the employer's confidential information.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Overly broad or perpetual confidentiality clauses can restrict normal professional activities after employment.

risk_types.label: Dispute Resolution
risk_types.description: Mechanisms for resolving disputes between employer and employee.
risk_types.risk_explanation: Unfavorable or overly employer-controlled dispute resolution may disadvantage the employee.

missing_clause_types.label: Missing: Dispute Resolution Mechanism
missing_clause_types.description: No dispute resolution or labor arbitration process is specified.
missing_clause_types.risk_explanation: Without a defined process, employees may not know how to seek legal remedies.

missing_clause_types.label: Missing: Termination Procedure
missing_clause_types.description: No clear process or notice period for contract termination is defined.
missing_clause_types.risk_explanation: Absence of termination procedures can enable sudden dismissal without proper compensation.

missing_clause_types.label: Missing: Wage / Compensation Details
missing_clause_types.description: Salary amount, payment date, or calculation method is not clearly stated.
missing_clause_types.risk_explanation: Vague or missing wage terms make it hard to claim unpaid wages.

missing_clause_types.label: Missing: Work Hours / Overtime Policy
missing_clause_types.description: Work schedule, overtime policy, or rest entitlements are not defined.
missing_clause_types.risk_explanation: Without explicit terms, employees may be expected to work excessive hours without proper compensation.

missing_clause_types.label: Missing: Data / Privacy Policy
missing_clause_types.description: No mention of how employee personal data will be collected, used, or retained.
missing_clause_types.risk_explanation: Absence of data terms can increase the risk of unregulated data usage.
